title: Grateful Dead Live at Marin County Veterans Auditorium on 1984-03-28
lineage: master cassette > Nakamichi Dragon (Dolby B) > HHB CDR 830plus > EAC > Sound Forge 5.0 > CD Wave Editor 1.71 > WAV > SHN
source: 2 Sony ECM 939LT stereo microphones > Marantz PMD 340 > TDK AD-X90  cassettes with Dolby B

ai_review.summary: Positive show with a smoky vibe and solid performance (especially Brent’s keyboard work), captured on an audience tape of decent quality.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rate the concert highly, calling it a great and smokin' show and highlighting Brent's tasteful acoustic playing. The audio is described as an audience recording that isn’t bad but could benefit from a crisp SBD mastering.

ai_rating.rationale: Two enthusiastic 4‑star reviews point to a strong musical performance and an acceptable audience recording; limited sample size keeps confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers say the audio is 'not too bad' for an audience source, with no major drop‑outs or distortion mentioned but a desire for a cleaner SBD master.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on pacing; reviewers simply praise the overall vibe and musicianship.

band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s tinkling acoustic keyboard work is highlighted as a beautiful element of the show.
